_about: CLASS PLANS (user 2026-10-10): which class each character becomes at level 20 / 40 / 76. Edited on the dashboard Classes page (#/classes); read live by every swarm.js window (no restart). A character changes class ONLY when its plan here is approved, valid in Scripts/data/class_tree.json and its next step is a profession of its current class; no plan / not approved = it never changes class. parties.<leader>.members.<character> = { plan: [1st, 2nd, 3rd profession class ids], approved, approvedBy, approvedAt, note }. templates.<id> = { name, desc, example, slots: [{ label, role, from: base class id, plan }] } — a group template is applied to a party on the Classes page (members are matched by their current class and role; the user confirms). The examples below are marked example: true.

example-raid-9.name: Raid team (9): Shillien tank, healers, destroyers, dark damage
example-raid-9.desc: Example. A Shillien Templar tank, Cardinal + Shillien Saint healing, two Titans, a Doombringer, a Soultaker, a Soul Hound (dark debuffs) and a Doomcryer.

example-dwarf-trio.name: Spoil & craft trio
example-dwarf-trio.desc: Example. A crafter (Maestro), a spoiler (Fortune Seeker) and an Elven healer (Eva's Saint).

example-elven-mages.name: Elven mage party
example-elven-mages.desc: Example. Shillien Templar tank, Cardinal, Doomcryer and Elven nukers (Mystic Muse). Unused slots are skipped.

example-dark-mages.name: Dark Elven mage party
example-dark-mages.desc: Example. Shillien Templar tank, Cardinal, Doomcryer, a Titan and Dark Elven wind nukers (Storm Screamer).

example-orc-destroyers.name: Orc destroyer party
example-orc-destroyers.desc: Example. Titans, a Cardinal and a Doomcryer.
